source_review_20261123.law_clause: Every motorcycle or moped when being driven on the highway is entitled to full use of the traffic lane it is occupying, and a person shall not drive another motor vehicle in a manner which would deprive any such motorcycle or moped of such use.
source_review_20261123.current_cell_support: The C230254 control is motorcycle; moped remains a separate protected alternative requiring compatible classification and scene support.
source_review_20261123.chapter_specific_highway: Record public maintenance and public vehicular access under NRS 486.031 before treating the road as a chapter 486 highway.
source_review_20261123.classification_sources: Record vehicle body, seat/saddle, wheels and applicable chapter 486 exclusions for the protected vehicle; do not infer classification from catalog control label.
source_review_20261123.legal_standard: Full use and deprivation remain unresolved qualitative judgments; no clearance cutoff, collision, overlap, lane change, or motorcycle reaction is mandated by the text.
